Dear Allseas Crew Operations Team,

I am writing to apply for the Crew Operations Coordinator role in Essen. With a background in logistics, web systems, and client coordination, I bring the organisational discipline and calm-under-pressure mindset your team needs.

At Katoen Natie, I worked in a high-volume logistics environment where accuracy and speed were critical. At Episto, I manage multiple client projects, track documentation, and coordinate with stakeholders remotely. I am used to taking ownership of planning, speaking up when details need attention, and keeping oversight during busy periods.

I am confident in English and comfortable with systems, documentation, and logistics coordination. I would welcome the chance to support your crew changes and ensure smooth mobilisation for offshore personnel.

Thank you for your consideration.

cover_letter:
Dear Allseas Crew Operations Team,

I am applying for the Crew Operations Coordinator position in Essen. Your description of a role that demands ownership, clear communication, and calm under pressure matches how I work. I am drawn to the operational heartbeat of crew changes and the responsibility of getting people and documentation where they need to be, on time.

At Katoen Natie, I worked in a high-volume logistics environment where accuracy and efficiency were non-negotiable. That experience taught me to stay focused during peak periods, follow strict procedures, and communicate clearly with colleagues when priorities shift. More recently, at Episto, I manage multiple client projects remotely. I coordinate content, documentation, and timelines, track performance, and keep stakeholders informed. This has strengthened my ability to plan, prioritise, and handle day-to-day queries with a diplomatic but assertive approach.

I am comfortable with systems and documentation. I learn new tools quickly and have a technical foundation that helps me pick up planning software and logistics platforms without friction. My English is professional, and I am improving my Dutch. I understand the importance of verifying details like passports, visas, and certificates before a crew change, and I am eager to apply that care to offshore mobilisations.

I would welcome the opportunity to contribute to your team, support vessel crews, and help keep operations running smoothly. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
